title: ICT Risk Management Framework
summary: Defines identification/assessment/treatment of ICT risks; annual board review not yet formalised.

title: Incident Management Standard
summary: Internal incident severity scale (P1-P4); no regulator notification workflow or deadlines.

title: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
summary: RTO/RPO per service; annual DR test; scenario library limited to data-centre loss.

title: Third-Party & Outsourcing Policy
summary: Vendor onboarding due diligence; no register distinguishing critical/important functions.

title: Cloud Usage Policy
summary: Approved cloud providers; shared-responsibility model; exit strategy guidance is informal.

title: Penetration Testing Standard
summary: Annual external pen test of internet-facing systems; no threat-led (TLPT) programme.

title: Model Risk Management Policy
summary: Validation lifecycle for credit and capital models; AI/ML-specific controls thin.

title: Data Governance Policy
column7: ownership; training-data governance for ML not covered.

title: Vendor Contract Clause Library
summary: Standard clauses; lacks audit/access rights and sub-outsourcing terms for ICT.

title: Board Training & Competence Policy
summary: Induction and annual training plan; no ICT/operational-resilience module.

title: Threat Intelligence & Information Sharing
summary: Consumes commercial feeds; no framework for sharing within trusted communities.
